name: Macro-tide-armed broad momentum (risk-on regime gates a 20d trend; gate, not trend-alone)
rationale: THESIS: Crypto momentum fires identically in every tape — the chop and the risk-off bleed where it loses as much as the risk-on runs where it wins. The orthogonal structure is the macro GATE, not the trend. macro_regime is a next-day-available FRED curve+real-rates+liquidity composite (BOUNDED); when it sits above its fitted risk-on floor, growth-beta assets are being PAID a risk premium and trend persists, while below it the same breakout is a bull trap in a de-risking tape (documented macro->crypto coupling: crypto's equity-beta is regime-dependent and rises in risk-off). We only arm the long-only 20d-ish spot trend WHEN the macro window is open. DISCONFIRMER: run the IDENTICAL ret_Nd>mom_floor entry with macro_regime REMOVED (trend-alone). If gated and ungated produce statistically indistinguishable deflated-Sharpe net of the extra fees from regime-exit churn, the gate adds nothing and this is disguised momentum — falsified. The gate must add risk-adjusted return net of cost. Hedge funds run the fast leveraged-perp version; the slow daily long-only spot edge sits below their capacity floor.
catalyst: Macro regime composite sits above its fitted risk-on floor while a multi-week price trend is already up — the macro window arms a trend that would otherwise also fire in losing risk-off tapes.
